title: Generic short exact sequence with filtered source
statement: Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme [def-pc-scheme, pqf-def-locnoeth], $T$ a closed subset with generic point $\xi$, and $F$ a coherent module [pqf-def-coherent, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] with support $T$. Suppose the maximal ideal of $\mathcal O_{X,\xi}$ annihilates the module stalk $F_\xi$ [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk]. There are coherent modules $A,Q$ and a short exact sequence $0\to A\to F\to Q\to0$ such that $A$ has a coherent integral-ideal filtration [def-weil-pbc-coherent-integral-filtration] and the support of $Q$ is strictly contained in $T$. No smaller-support induction hypothesis is required.

source.place: Tag 01YF, irreducible-support ideal-power and final generic-point paragraphs; Tag 01YE for the generic ideal inclusion. Read online at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01YF and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01YE.

proof.text: Give T its reduced induced closed subscheme structure. Its generic point is xi, by uniqueness, and irreducibility and reducedness make the subscheme integral.

Apply the generic-point ideal inclusion to obtain a monomorphism from a finite sum of a coherent ideal pushforward into F, invertible near xi. Since xi is in the support of F, apply the ideal-sum cokernel reduction to get a nonzero ideal, coherent source A and coherent cokernel Q with support strictly contained in T.
Filter A by partial sums of the nonzero ideal pushforward. The mono and its actual cokernel projection form the required short exact sequence. No support induction and no filtration of F is asserted.

proof_origin.based_on: Construction subproblem extracted from the literal Stacks 01YF proof, not a restatement of an existing filtration theorem.

lean.statement:
theorem coherent_generic_filtered_extension
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X]
    (T : TopologicalSpace.Closeds X) (ξ : X)
    (hξ : IsGenericPoint ξ (T : Set X))
    (F : X.Modules) (hF : RingedSpace.IsCoherent X.toRingedSpace F)
    (hSupp : {x : X | ¬ Subsingleton (F.presheaf.stalk x)} = (T : Set X))
    (hkill : ∀ a ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk ξ),
      ∀ m : (RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X.toRingedSpace ξ).obj F, a • m = 0) :
    ∃ (A Q : X.Modules) (f : A ⟶ F) (g : F ⟶ Q) (w : f ≫ g = 0),
      (ShortComplex.mk f g w).ShortExact ∧
      RingedSpace.IsCoherent X.toRingedSpace A ∧
      RingedSpace.IsCoherent X.toRingedSpace Q ∧ HasCoherentIntegralFiltration A ∧
      {x : X | ¬ Subsingleton (Q.presheaf.stalk x)} ⊂ (T : Set X)
